title: rateyourbuild
blurb: RateYourMusic for the bot's back catalog: rate every site @buildthis.bisks.net has ever built, 0-10, with an optional written review — public, editable, weighted by vote count. Every site gets its own page (genre, subgenre, build date, top-10 rankings), every genre gets a page of its own with a description and its sub/super genres. asked for by @angussoftware.dev.
